content:
Hi everyone. I recently put together a short open access book called Learning Lean Through Architecture. It focuses specifically on the math and computer science behind the omega tactic.

I know the formal literature on automated reasoning can be quite dense so I wanted to create a highly visual beginner friendly resource. It uses physical building metaphors and my own hand drawn illustrations to explain concepts like Presburger arithmetic and finite automata.

It is completely free and available to at zenodo.org/records/21435216 for anyone interested. I would love feedback from this community.
